task_message:
Case M15: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 220x220x132 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is finished. 

**Summary:** The myxoid soft-tissue tumor is a large, bilobed, strongly T2-hyperintense popliteal mass. Using the case overview and contact sheets in all three planes, I mapped its extent (axial 31–122, coronal 35–97, sagittal 45–155) and seeded the model with three positive points on the largest axial cross-section. The resulting single-component mask closely followed the lesion's bright core plus its heterogeneous periphery in every plane; I verified both ends of each axis and the smaller satellite lobule, and rejected the automatic candidate proposals, which outlined perilesional fat/muscle rather than tumor. Final mask: 224.4 mL, saved with medium confidence.
